name: moviemate-web
description: Unit tests for the pure client-side logic in this folder (match-engine.js). No Firebase or network involved — see rules-tests/ for the Firestore security-rules suite, which is the only other automated coverage this client has.

scripts.build:firebase: rm -f firebase-auth-entry.js firebase-firestore-entry.js firebase-shared-chunk-*.js && esbuild vendor-src/firebase-auth-entry.js vendor-src/firebase-firestore-entry.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --platform=browser --minify --outdir=. --outbase=vendor-src --chunk-names=firebase-shared-chunk-[hash]
